A '''dermatoglyphic pattern'''<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref> or '''dermatoglyphic record'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a unique skin pattern that most [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] developed. They were usually located on a individual's thumb or similar appendage. Databases of dermatoglyphic patterns were stored on criminals, [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]], and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-allied corporations. [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] dermatoglyphic patterns were taken from their noses, as many Wookiee slaves had scarred or missing fingers, making identification problematic.<ref name="Abduction" /> 

Imperial [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] contained an individual's dermatoglyphic record, as well as voice and retinal prints, to verify the owner's identity at specialized scanners. Dermatoglyphic patterns could also be used as a secondary identification method for security systems such as [[electronic lock]]s.<ref name="EGWT" />
